policy.title: Policy planning
policy.intro: Choose an indicator, trace its possible causes, and consider actions at each level.
policy.candidateNote: Only observed possible causes are shown. Open an action's screen to make a plan.
policy.pending: An epoch is running. Investigation resumes when it finishes.
policy.noData: There are no relevant residents or households, or no epoch results yet.
policy.noFindings: No matching problem was found among the defined checks.
policy.actionError: Could not open the action screen.

no_vacancies.title: Current job quotas are full
no_vacancies.evidence: {{count}} residents are seeking work. Job quota: {{quota}}; employed labor: {{labor}}. Both labor figures use effective labor units.

unfilled_jobs.title: Vacancies and unemployment coexist
unfilled_jobs.evidence: {{count}} job seekers and {{vacancies}} vacant effective labor units. Check skills, commuting, and net pay.

public_budget.title: Public facilities are constrained by budgets
public_budget.evidence: Operating budgets constrain plans at {{count}} facilities. Funding can also help restore job quotas.

education_gap.title: Some job seekers lack basic education
education_gap.evidence: All skills of {{count}} job seekers are in the uneducated tier. Education improves future skills and wages.

no_schools.title: No educational facilities are operating
no_schools.evidence: There are no facilities providing education. Plan accessible locations and operating budgets as well as construction.

specialists.title: Specialist shortages prevent facilities from operating
specialists.evidence: {{count}} facilities lack highly skilled workers. Adding general workers alone will not resolve this.

household_unemployment.title: Some households include unemployed adults
household_unemployment.evidence: {{count}} households include unemployed working-age residents, a possible source of missing wage income. The branches below describe citywide employment.

no_income.title: Some households have no income
no_income.evidence: {{count}} households have average daily income of zero or less. Check benefits and their funding alongside employment measures.

basic_consumption.title: Some households remain in the basic consumption tier
basic_consumption.evidence: {{count}} households are in the lowest demand tier. Check whether income leaves room after living costs.

security_response.title: Security services have not fully suppressed damage
security_response.evidence: {{count}} cases of crime damage were recorded in the latest epoch. Check police capacity and service reach.

no_police.title: No police stations are operating
no_police.evidence: No police stations provide security services. Choose locations that can reach affected areas.

police_staff.title: Police stations lack workers
police_staff.evidence: Labor shortages constrained production at {{count}} facilities. The branches below show citywide hiring issues.

police_budget.title: Police operating budgets are insufficient
police_budget.evidence: Budgets have reduced next-epoch plans at {{count}} facilities.

police_inputs.title: Police stations lack materials
police_inputs.evidence: Material shortages were observed at {{count}} facilities. Use facility diagnosis to check missing goods and supply routes.

unemployment_pressure.title: Unemployment contributes to security problems
unemployment_pressure.evidence: There are {{count}} unemployed adults. In this game, unemployed adults contribute to worsening security, so employment measures can help address it.

public_jobs.title: Create jobs in public facilities
public_jobs.description: Open construction. Employment after completion also needs an operating budget.

population.title: Reduce population by expelling citizens
population.description: Open the citizen list and choose a person. This also removes population and potential future workers.

budget.title: Allocate operating budgets
budget.description: Allocate funds to the relevant sectors in the budget screen. Check how increases will be funded.

education.title: Provide basic education
education.description: Plan schools in construction. This helps the next generation rather than immediately employing today's adults.

higher_education.title: Develop specialists through higher education
higher_education.description: Plan a university and reserve places in the needed majors. Graduation takes time.

welfare.title: Adjust benefits and income support
welfare.description: Use Social Security in Regulations. Benefits also require a social security budget.

employment.title: Examine hiring conditions in employment statistics
employment.description: Check vacancies by skill and wages in the statistics screen's Employment tab.

police.title: Place police stations
police.description: Open construction. Consider locations that reach affected areas and their operating costs.

facilities.title: Inspect facility operation and shortages
facilities.description: Open public facilities, then use a relevant facility's details and diagnosis to investigate.
